why: Stops refusing a spawn sealed by destructibles in a pocket too small to survive blowing it. Only a mine clears a destructible (destructibleByBlast, mines.ts) and a mine kills within MINE_BLAST_RADIUS + TANK_RADIUS = 2.5, so the player pays a LIFE to leave the start line -- which is exactly how Keystone shipped, whose spawn pockets measure 1.18 to 1.72 across. The solid-connectivity half of the gate does NOT catch it: Keystone's spawns are reachable once the destructibles are gone, so without this line the board reads as suitable again.
killedBy: spawn egress: a tank, not a cell (issue #423) a destructible seal is FATAL when the pocket is smaller than the mine blast
versusBoardCatalog produces one row per (arena, N), labelled with the arena id, over the default 8 arenas x {2,3,4}
